tools.name: image_attach
tools.description: Attach one image file from the local disk to this conversation. Give its absolute path; the receipt carries the image as a [blob ...] line with a log: handle you can hand to image-sending tools. Accepts png, jpg, jpeg, gif and webp up to 5 MB.

path.description: Absolute path of the image file on this machine.

summary.zh: 读取硬盘上的一张图片,作为附件交给这次对话,回执给 log: 句柄。
summary.en: Reads one image file from disk into the conversation as an attachment and returns its log: handle.

changelog.0.1.0: - 首个版本:`image_attach`,把硬盘上的一张图片读成对话附件,回执给 `log:` 句柄。
